Trends and Economic Conditions Outlook for Key End Markets In Construction Industries, we expect another year of sales of equipment to end users growth in 2026 compared to 2025, supported by elevated order rates and a robust backlog.

For turbines and turbine-related services used in Oil & Gas applications, we expect another year of strong sales in 2026 comparable to our record 2025 performance as backlog remains healthy, with continued solid order and inquiry activity.

The strong backlog coupled with healthy end markets supports our expectations for sales volume growth in all three primary segments, as well as favorable price realization of about 2 percent of sales and revenues.

We also have long-term contractual obligations primarily for logistics services agreements; systems support, software licenses and development contracts; information technology consulting contracts; outsourcing contracts for benefit plan administration and long-term commitments entered into with key suppliers for minimum purchase quantities.
